'''Ralf Jürgen Spatzier''' is a [[British American]] mathematician specialising in [[differential geometry]], [[dynamical systems]], and [[ergodic theory]].

Spatzier received his Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[University of Warwick]] in 1983 under the joint supervision of [[Caroline Series]] and [[Anatole Katok]]<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=15875}}</ref> and joined [[Stony Brook University]] as an assistant professor. In 1990 he moved to the [[University of Michigan]] where he is now a full professor.<ref>{{cite web|title=Curriculum vitae: Ralf Spatzier|publisher=University of Michigan|accessdate=2015-04-07|url=http://www.math.lsa.umich.edu/~spatzier/cv.html}}</ref> He is a [[fellow]] of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2015-04-07.</ref>
